_comment: Winter Park, FL (Orange County) -- Stage 1 expansion, DEEPENED to 7 verified providers (2026-09-21). Ratings from Google Places API (permitted). Every tagged treatment CONFIRMED against the clinic's OWN website menu (see each _sourcing.menu_confirmed). No scraped review text; prices not published by these providers -> request-a-quote; nothing fabricated; no before/after images. Widened-supply rule #42 applied: dermatology + plastic-surgery practices count as sources for non-surgical treatments they list on their own menu. Look Lab Med Spa (132 N Park Ave, 5.0/1277) and Vitalounge (515 N Park Ave, 4.9/1177) were NOT included: Look Lab trips the perfect-at-volume integrity flag and its HydraFacial/microneedling appear only in reviews (not a clean itemized menu); Vitalounge's site is JS-gated and could not be menu-confirmed this run. Restore Hyper Wellness omitted: HydraFacial confirmed only at brand level ('not all services available at all locations'), not for the Winter Park studio.
